tools.name: list_tickets
tools.title: List Zendesk Tickets
tools.description: List tickets in the account, most recently updated first, or look them up by external id. Use it to browse the queue; search runs a filtered query and get_ticket reads one ticket in full.

external_id.description: List the tickets that carry this external id instead of paging through the account.

page.description: Offset page number, for use with per_page. Zendesk rejects mixing the offset shape with the cursor shape.

per_page.description: Number of tickets to return per page. The maximum is 100.

sort_by.description: Order the results by this field.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.title: Get Zendesk Ticket
tools.description: Show one ticket in full: status, priority, tags, assignee, group and custom fields. Use it after list_tickets or search to read a single ticket, and before add_ticket_comment to reply to it.

tools.name: list_ticket_comments
tools.title: List Zendesk Ticket Comments
tools.description: List the comments on a ticket in chronological order, including public replies and internal notes. Use it to read the conversation before replying, and pass page_after with the cursor Zendesk reports to read the page that follows.

page_after.description: Cursor token from the previous page, to read the page that follows it.

page_size.description: Number of comments to return per page. The maximum is 100.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket whose comments should be listed.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Zendesk
tools.description: Search tickets, users and organizations with Zendesk's query syntax, for example `type:ticket status:open priority:high`. Use it for a filtered lookup; list_tickets is the unfiltered browse.

per_page.description: Number of results per page. The maximum is 100.

query.description: The search query, in Zendesk search syntax (for example `type:ticket status:open`).

sort_by.description: Order the results by this field.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.title: Get Current Zendesk User
tools.description: Show the user record the stored credential authenticates as. Use it to confirm which Zendesk account and identity the vault entry belongs to.

tools.name: list_users
tools.title: List Zendesk Users
tools.description: List the users in the account, one page at a time, optionally filtered by role or external id. Use it to find a requester or assignee id before creating a ticket. The API exposes no sort parameter, so users come back in Zendesk's own order; pass page_after with the cursor Zendesk reports to read the page that follows.

external_id.description: Return the user that carries this external id.

page_after.description: Cursor token from the previous page, to read the page that follows it.

page_size.description: Number of users to return per page. The maximum is 100.

role.description: Return only users with this role.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.title: List Zendesk Organizations
tools.description: List the organizations in the account, one page at a time. Use it to find an organization id when grouping requesters or reporting on a client's accounts. Pass page_after with the cursor Zendesk reports to read the page that follows.

page_after.description: Cursor token from the previous page, to read the page that follows it.

page_size.description: Number of organizations to return per page. The maximum is 100.

tools.name: list_views
tools.title: List Zendesk Views
tools.description: List the account's views: the saved ticket filters agents work from, such as unsolved tickets or your assigned tickets. Use it to find a view id for list_view_tickets. Pass page_after with the cursor Zendesk reports to read the page that follows.

page_after.description: Cursor token from the previous page, to read the page that follows it.

page_size.description: Number of views to return per page. The maximum is 100.

tools.name: list_view_tickets
tools.title: List Zendesk Tickets In A View
tools.description: List the tickets in one view, in the order that view defines. Use list_views first when the view id is unknown. Pass page_after with the cursor Zendesk reports to read the page that follows.

page_after.description: Cursor token from the previous page, to read the page that follows it.

page_size.description: Number of tickets to return per page. The maximum is 100.

view_id.description: The id of the view whose tickets should be listed.

annotations.title: List Zendesk Tickets In A View

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.title: Create Zendesk Ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket for a requester, optionally with an opening comment. Use it to open a case; add_ticket_comment replies to a ticket that already exists. A public comment notifies the requester, and creating a ticket fires the account's triggers and webhooks.

comment_body.description: The first comment on the ticket. Omit it to open the ticket with no comment.

public.description: Applies to the opening comment: set false to record it as an internal note instead of emailing the requester.

requester_email.description: The requester's email address. Zendesk matches an existing user by email; pair it with requester_name to create one that does not exist yet. Provide requester_email or requester_id: Zendesk needs one of the two.

requester_id.description: The id of an existing user to set as the requester. Takes precedence over requester_email; requester_name is ignored when it is set.

requester_name.description: The requester's name. Zendesk needs it when requester_email does not match an existing user.

subject.description: The ticket's subject line. Optional for Zendesk, but a ticket without one reads as unnamed in the agent queue.

tags.description: Tags to set on the ticket.

tools.name: add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Add Zendesk Ticket Comment
tools.description: Append a comment to an existing ticket, either as a public reply to the requester or as an internal note. A public comment emails the requester and cannot be un-sent.

public.description: Set false to keep the comment as an internal note instead of emailing it to the requester.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket to comment on.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.title: Update Zendesk Ticket
tools.description: Change an existing ticket: status, priority, assignee, group, subject, type or tags. Use it to triage a ticket that already exists; create_ticket opens a new one and add_ticket_comment replies. Set status "solved" to resolve and "closed" to close. Tags replace the ticket's whole tag set. A status or assignee change fires the account's triggers and can notify the requester.

assignee_id.description: The id of the agent to assign the ticket to. Use list_users to find it. Pass null to unassign.

group_id.description: The id of the group to move the ticket to. Read the group ids from the ticket's own detail with get_ticket.

status.description: The ticket's status. "solved" resolves it and "closed" closes it permanently.

tags.description: The ticket's tags. This replaces the whole tag set; send the values to keep alongside the new ones.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket to update.

tools.name: get_user
tools.title: Get Zendesk User
tools.description: Show one user in full: role, email, organization and external id. Use it after list_users to read a requester or assignee, and to fetch the id create_ticket or update_ticket needs.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.title: Get Zendesk Organization
tools.description: Show one organization in full: name, domains, tags and notes. Use it after list_organizations to read a client's organization, for grouping requesters or reporting.

tools.name: count_view_tickets
tools.title: Count Zendesk Tickets In A View
tools.description: Count the tickets in one view without fetching them. Use it to size a queue before reading it; list_view_tickets returns the tickets themselves. The count can be stale (`fresh: false`) while Zendesk refreshes it asynchronously.

view_id.description: The id of the view whose ticket count should be read.

annotations.title: Count Zendesk Tickets In A View

tools.name: get_ticket_metrics
tools.title: Get Zendesk Ticket Metrics
tools.description: Read a ticket's metrics: first-reply and full-resolution times, reply counts and reassignment history. Use it for SLA reporting and to judge how a ticket was handled. Returns a single `ticket_metric` object.

ticket_id.description: The id of the ticket whose metrics should be read.
